sloka: विचुक्रुशुस्तदा सङ्ख्ये भीमं लङ्कानिवासिनः।निकुम्भेनोद्यतं दृष्ट्वा हनुमन्तं महाबलम् ।। ६.७७.१९ ।।
transliteration: vicukruśustadā saṅkhye bhīmaṁ laṅkānivāsinaḥ।nikumbhenodyataṁ dṛṣṭvā hanumantaṁ mahābalam ।। 6.77.19 ।।

translations.english: Even while being carried by Rakshasa also, the son of the wind god hit Kumbhakarna's son with his hard adamant fist.
